g.text: Figure S3 | Muscle-tendon parameter sensitivity of the biarticular hamstring load

Baseline (Nominal-posture) sensitivity via WHOLE-MOTION re-optimization, NOT dose-response-slope sensitivity. N=50. Red ring = achieved speed drifted >1.5% (operating point moved); x = failed solve. See source CSV for per-solve
speed/tilt. Failed: HamTendon x1.10=Maximum_CpuTime_Exceeded (speed 7.12); Passive force-length not run (needs per-muscle Fpparam).
